name: T3 TT
summary: Current exact-model evidence identifies T3 TT / T3 铁三 TT as a high-modulus carbon triathlon platform with a current WheelTop TX-TT7110 build. The dated mainland price remains historical; maximum tire clearance and frame-only weight are still unpublished.

frame.construction: Aerodynamic high-modulus carbon frame and fork with 12×142/12×100 mm thru-axles, matching aero carbon seatpost and fully internal routing; the lay-up schedule and molding process are not published
frame.stiffness_evidence: The current manufacturer page describes the exact T3 TT frame and fork as designed for maximum stiffness, while one exact-model owner reports twitchier handling than other TT bikes used. Neither source provides a measured stiffness, deflection or independent comparative protocol.

category_details.aero_bars: High-modulus carbon integrated TT base bar and stem, 400×100 mm, with 45° extensions and 260 mm support arms
category_details.note: Current WheelTop TX-TT7110 2×12 configuration. The manufacturer publishes fitted 700×28C tires but no maximum tire clearance or triathlon storage/box specification.
